connector.name: OrgGen AI
connector.registryDescription: Generate org charts, MCD/ERD data models, and C4 architecture diagrams - pilot OrgGen AI via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at orggen.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.orggen, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Generate an API key from https://www.orggen.ai/settings (Pro plan required).

headers.name: X-Project-Id
headers.description: Optional. UUID of the project to operate on. If omitted, the key's stored active_project_id is used — set it once via the set_active_project tool and forget. Override per-call by passing this header.
